description: March 11 birthday meaning: Pisces decan 3, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a March 11 birthday falls in Pisces, in the third decan, with Neptune as the sign's ruler and Pluto as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Pisces is mutable and water.

sections.heading: The March 11 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Pisces enters its final decan around March 11, where Pluto, modern ruler of Scorpio, adds intensity to Neptune's sea. The Sun sits about twenty degrees into the sign, and master number 11 heightens intuition. Read together, this is one of the calendar's most intuition-led birthdays, often linked with deep perception and transformative creativity.

Astronomically, March 11 puts the Sun near 20° Pisces in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Pluto. Pluto, modern ruler of Scorpio, governs the last ten degrees of Pisces, which cover roughly March 11 to March 20. At the very end of the zodiac, the sign's empathy gains depth, focus and a capacity for transformation. Those born here are often described as perceptive, private and drawn to the hidden side of life, whether psychology, mystery or spiritual work. Feelings run strong and sometimes stay unspoken. Pluto adds resilience and a talent for helping others through change. When this decan trusts its intensity rather than hiding it, sensitivity tends to become a genuine strength.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for March 11
paragraphs: Born on the 11th, you have a birthday number of 11, and because it is a master number it stays unreduced. The day of birth is a secondary number in numerology, yet master numbers are traditionally given extra weight wherever they appear. Two 1s side by side suggest doubled sensitivity as well as doubled initiative: the 11 is linked with intuition, inspiration and a nervous, creative charge. Those born on this date are often described as idealistic and perceptive, sometimes picking up on things before they can explain why. Grounding routines and trusted company tend to help them carry that intensity comfortably.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a March 11 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous March 11 birthdays
paragraphs: A March birthday falls around the spring equinox for the northern hemisphere, the season of thaw and first growth, while southern birthdays mark the turn into autumn. The month is split between Pisces and Aries, with the change around March 20 or 21. In numerology March is month 3, linked with expression, creativity and sociability, a lively number for a month that ends with the zodiac starting over. March 11 is the 70th day of the year (71st in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Aries, is usually complete within 10 days, by March 21.

By March 11 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a March 11 birthday are Harold Wilson (1916), Rupert Murdoch (1931) and Qasem Soleimani (1957).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is March 11?
faq.answer: March 11 is Pisces in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Pisces, which tradition links with Pluto.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on March 11?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On March 11 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 22 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 11th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on March 11?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by March 11, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on March 11?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on March 11 include Harold Wilson (1916), Rupert Murdoch (1931) and Qasem Soleimani (1957). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
